description: The daemon's hangs over 250 ms in the STRESS storm window on a bench build: server-stats include hangs (the hang watcher over request, journal, holder-link and echo scopes, p12-perf-process-232) read on the daemon's own socket when trace.py's window opens and when it closes; the count's growth and each hang's duration, with its span in the summary. A daemon without the section is not-measurable, never 0.
